keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: Video generation
keywords.about: Video generators and diffusion models synthesize, edit, and accelerate text- or image-conditioned video.

keywords.name: 3D scene understanding
keywords.about: 3D scene, point-cloud, and voxel methods infer geometry, flow, and spatial relations.

keywords.name: Anatomical imaging
keywords.about: Anatomy-aware models generate, register, and evaluate medical images across modalities.

keywords.name: Egocentric vision
keywords.about: Egocentric video and sensing support hand tracking, robot learning, and humanoid foresight.

keywords.name: Coding agents
keywords.about: Coding agents are tested on games, harness recovery, and persistent work environments.

keywords.name: Long video understanding
keywords.about: Long-video agents and VLMs build compact memory and token budgets for hour-scale understanding.

keywords.name: Question answering

keywords.name: Decision models

themes.name: LLM and multimodal evaluation, benchmarks, and deployment guardrails
themes.summary: Papers audit and improve the validity of evaluation for language and multimodal models. They diagnose benchmark bias, chain-of-thought faithfulness, object hallucination, judge reliability, and answer-evidence gaps, while proposing calibrated scoring and statistical guardrails for deployment. The work includes new benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and causal methods for trustworthy measurement.

themes.name: Robot learning, world models, and motion planning
themes.summary: Papers develop vision-language-action policies, learned world models, and motion planners for robot manipulation, navigation, and control. They cover VLA deployment, human-robot interaction, bimanual dexterity, future prediction, and simulation-to-real transfer. The work spans policy learning, world-model architectures, and evaluation of robustness and physical grounding.
members: 2026-11-26: World-Action Models and VLA Robot Policies

themes.name: Visual generation, diffusion models, and 3D reconstruction
themes.summary: Papers advance generative visual synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction using diffusion, flow matching, Gaussian splatting, and occupancy representations. They improve sparse-view reconstruction, video generation and editing, long-video understanding, and feed-forward geometry. Some emphasize efficiency and optimization, while others focus on novel-view synthesis and geometric accuracy.
members: 2026-11-24: Diffusion and Flow Matching Generative Models

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference, compression, and adaptation
themes.summary: Papers reduce the computational and memory cost of large language model training and inference. They introduce speculative decoding, KV cache compression, quantization, token pruning, and parameter-efficient adapters such as LoRA. The contributions span algorithmic compression, hardware-aware kernels, and adaptation or merging of pretrained models.

2026-11-26: Efficient Adaptation and Merging of Pretrained Models

themes.name: RL post-training and reward modeling
themes.summary: Papers investigate reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation for post-training language and multimodal models. They focus on verifiable rewards, process reward modeling, credit assignment, and reward hacking. Methods include self-distillation, best-of-N selection, and RL-based post-training to improve reasoning and reliability.

themes.name: LLM agents, multi-agent orchestration, and security
themes.summary: Papers in this cluster design and secure LLM agent systems with tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and recovery. They address indirect prompt injection, communication reliability, workflow security downgrades, and shared-memory poisoning, while providing harnesses, benchmarks, and defensive frameworks. Some works focus on measuring agent failures, others on repairing them through oversight and obligation-preserving recovery.

themes.name: Biomedical AI, clinical imaging, and physiological sensing
themes.summary: Papers apply AI to clinical and physiological domains, including medical imaging, pathology, clinical language, wearable and EEG signals, and affective computing. They build segmentation and diagnostic models, medical reasoning agents, emotion recognition systems, and human pose or tactile sensing pipelines. The contributions vary from foundation models and benchmarks to robustness audits and human-robot interaction.

themes.name: Interpretability and model editing
themes.summary: Papers analyze and edit neural network internals through mechanistic interpretability, sparse autoencoders, linear probing, and activation steering. They study representation geometry, feature stability, polysemanticity, and causal abstractions, while also developing model merging and weight-space interventions for controllable adaptation.

themes.name: AI safety, privacy, and robustness
themes.summary: Papers study vulnerabilities and defenses for machine learning systems with respect to privacy, integrity, and adversarial robustness. They cover federated learning, backdoor and bit-flip attacks, privacy leakage, deepfakes, watermarking, and differential privacy. Some propose robust aggregation, auditing, or unlearning, while others benchmark attacks and failure modes.

news.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
news.summary: OpenAI reports in a preprint titled "GPT-6 as a Universal Foundation Model for Protein Biology: Beyond Specialized Models" that its GPT-6 family can design protein structures and amino acid sequences using only reasoning and coding tools, without calling specialized biology models. In lab tests with Onava, proteins based on GPT-6.2's designs showed evidence of binding across five targets, and an internal research model matched or outperformed specialized models on many of the 14 protein tasks tested.

news.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
news.summary: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, used OpenAI's Codex and Astra to search public telescope data for exoplanet transits; Bond scanned about 100,000 Kepler stars and flagged more than 200 signals, including 10 from previously confirmed planets, while Byrd analyzed data from about 19 million stars. An independent SETI Institute search found two of the same signals in the Kepler data, and one of Byrd's candidates was sent to TESS researchers for further analysis.

news.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
news.summary: OpenAI describes how Marina Petrova, CEO of Intentful, uses a personalized ChatGPT-based agent named Aria to research and draft client proposals. The text reports that Aria reviewed about 300 website sitemaps against criteria such as a readable sitemap of no more than 3,000 pages, cutting proposal work from several days to a few hours, and that it pulls pricing from past agreements via HubSpot and uses templates from Google Drive.

news.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
news.summary: iFood describes its Remote Agents Platform, which accepts coding tasks via a REST API, runs them in an isolated Ubuntu sandbox with GPT-5.6 Luna, and returns a merge request, across its 15,000+ code repositories. The text cites 25,000+ completed runs at an average inference cost of US$0.04 per run and says vulnerabilities fixed through its internal security platform more than doubled.

news.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind released Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity, a suite of domain skills that pairs Gemini's reasoning with established mass spectrometry tools and public chemical databases to interpret tandem mass spectra and lay out structural evidence. The post states spectral library searches annotate on average only about 5% of measured spectra (10% for human samples), and reports >90% accuracy on structure prediction in most of the evaluations described.

news.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
news.summary: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents to find improved quantum circuits, with each result proved in the Lean theorem prover, and is open-sourcing its Lean library, problem specifications, and verified solutions. Reported gains include an 11.8x cost reduction and memory lowered from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits for an inertial confinement fusion calculation, 8x cheaper simulation of a light-sensitive molecule, a 2.5x improvement for Cytochrome P450 with memory cut from 481 to 333 qubits, a 2.57x speedup for a Grover's algorithm implementation, and a 290x speedup for arcsin.

news.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
news.summary: Google Research introduced an evaluation framework built on multi-agent social simulations in which a target agent with a hidden motive interacts with other agents, including one representing the user, who then consults the evaluated assistant to infer that motive, providing verifiable ground truth by construction. Testing diverse LLMs in this setup, the authors report that user mediation substantially complicates social reasoning, that models are sensitive to user framing and require more detail than humans to reach correct predictions, and that they fail to fully leverage clarification questions; the framework and dataset are open-sourced.

news.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
news.summary: Google Research presented DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that replaces fixed additive residual connections with learnable per-token routing weights and depth-wise cross-attention over previous layer embeddings, described in an ICML 2025 paper. The authors report models reaching the same quality up to three times faster with up to 30-40% fewer parameters and a negligible increase in parameters.

news.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
news.summary: Google expanded its partnership with Golden State, making Gemini the Official AI Assistant Partner and Official Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Partner of the Warriors, the 2026 WNBA Champion Valkyries, and Chase Center. The deal covers interactive videoboard and digital fan features plus internal deployment of Gemini for business to build custom AI agents.

news.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
news.summary: Google added Google Wallet and Google Drive to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode, rolling out Wallet opt-in first with Drive and the Gemini app support following in the coming weeks; these join Gmail, Calendar, and Photos. Connected Wallet data is read-only for AI Mode, which the post says cannot move, manage, or invest money, and users can manage connections in Search Personalization settings.

news.title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA's GeForce NOW update highlights community ambassadors and moderators alongside a Black Friday sale of 30% off the first six months of Performance and Ultimate memberships, running through Monday, Nov. 30. It also reports that War Thunder gains DLSS 5 support for Ultimate members, a Ready for Battle Pack reward is available across tiers, and 12 new games join the library.

news.title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season
news.summary: NVIDIA published a holiday gift guide covering GeForce RTX 50 Series laptops and desktops on the Blackwell architecture with fifth-generation Tensor Cores and fourth-generation RT Cores, RTX Spark PCs, DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, Reflex and G-SYNC, GeForce NOW with more than 4,500 titles, Studio Drivers, and the Jetson edge AI platform with the JetPack SDK for robot projects.

news.title: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
news.summary: NVIDIA describes an optimized SageAttention3 NVFP4 attention kernel for RTX Blackwell (SM120) that splits each N128 score tile into two N64 register slots and recycles registers after softmax quantization, overlapping the next tile's QK computation with the current tile's remaining operations. The schedule improves NVFP4 attention kernel latency by up to 1.64x on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, and Reactor integrated it into its production serving stack for world models with end-to-end latency reductions of up to 15.34% across LongLive, Helios, OmniDreams and Cosmos 3 Nano workloads; the core optimization was merged into the FlashInfer main branch.

news.title: How to Run NVIDIA Cosmos 3 on Local AI Devices Using Hugging Face Diffusers
news.summary: NVIDIA published a tutorial for running Cosmos 3 Nano, a world foundation model that generates video from text, images and other inputs, on GPUs with as little as 12 GB of VRAM using Hugging Face Diffusers and a Cosmos-Framework offloading package that keeps weights in system RAM. It cites benchmarks across GeForce RTX 5070, 5080, 4090 and 5090, with the RTX 5070 completing 720p text-to-video in 2,624.9 seconds at 9.94 GiB peak memory using BF16, and an FP8 checkpoint option.

news.title: Prepare Market Data for Forecasting with NVIDIA Megatron Core
news.summary: NVIDIA described a Megatron Core and Megatron-LM preprocessing pipeline that converts intraday market-bar Parquet files into model-ready tensors by grouping bars into patches, sliding fixed-length context windows, and computing return and trading-volume targets across multiple horizons. Saved splits (train.pt, val.pt, test.pt, meta.pt) keep parsing outside the training loop, and date-based splits with embargo periods and per-horizon statistics computed only from the training split guard against leakage.

news.title: What’s New for Game Developers: AI Animation and RTX Tools
news.summary: NVIDIA's game developer update covers Gaijin Entertainment integrating DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering into War Thunder's Dagor Engine, and NVIDIA Kimodo becoming the first AI motion-generation model in Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview's guided animation framework, generating character motion from text prompts, spline paths and target poses. It also lists In-Game Inferencing SDK 1.8, RTX Dynamic Illumination 3.2, Real-Time BVH Viewer 1.0 and RTX Path Tracing 1.9 updates.

news.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
news.summary: Hugging Face reports generating video with Lightricks' LTX-2.5 on an AWS Trainium3 machine (trn3.48xlarge, 64 NeuronCores) using diffusers pipelines. Once models were loaded, a 10-second clip with sound at 2048×1024 took 22 to 23 seconds on half the machine, which the author compares with LTX's stated 23.7 seconds for a 10-second 1080p clip via its API.

news.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
news.summary: Hugging Face introduced a llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware, letting users compare prompt processing (PP512) and text generation (TG128) throughput across builds, models, and quantizations. Current hardware choices are Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) and Radeon AI Pro R9700S (gfx1201); benchmarks run weekly with Flash Attention on and off and 10 repetitions per configuration, with results public in the ggml-org/install.sh-benches-data bucket.

news.title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
news.summary: Hugging Face released synthetic training datasets, a fine-tuning recipe, and a DFlash2 speculator for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Parse, a document model that converts page images into structured data with reading order, content classes, and bounding boxes. The open datasets are Synthetic Charts V1 (9.98M examples), Synthetic Tables V1 (1M), and OCR Synthetic Multilingual v2 (7.9M); a matched SFT-versus-GRPO comparison reports loop-flagged outputs falling from 126 to 29 pages and overall score rising from 66.24 to 71.38.

news.title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
news.summary: Hugging Face starts a blog series on building, training, and evaluating multi-agent systems, with a first example using four agents sharing one language model on a verifiable task that takes about five hours on two H200s at roughly $50. The post questions whether agent communication helps or just adds compute, citing OpenAI's roughly 10,000-agent result on 3D Navier-Stokes, a Hugging Face incident involving around 1,200 agents exchanging over 70,000 messages, and Noam Brown's estimate that less than 10% of the Navier-Stokes result came from multi-agent cooperation.

news.title: Introducing the Amazon Bedrock Trusted Access API, with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls for Claude models
news.summary: AWS announced general availability of the trusted access program API on Amazon Bedrock, a single place to discover, request and enroll in model provider trusted access programs, plus public preview of two Claude offerings built with Anthropic: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) and Enterprise Data Controls (EDC). With EFS, customer data stays in their own AWS account and prompts and completions are not retained by Anthropic or Amazon Bedrock; with EDC, retained data is stored in Amazon-managed storage.

news.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
news.summary: AWS Quick added a Meta ads AI connector giving Quick access to ads Model Context Protocol (MCP) server operations, so Meta ads customers can create, manage, and analyze campaigns in natural language. The demo shows prompts producing an eight-slide launch-plan deck and a dashboard comparing spend, leads, and cost per lead for two ad sets.

news.title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
news.summary: AWS Quick released updates including flows built and refined through chat with deterministic steps and longer-running workflows, an updated web app with a daily briefing that keeps work running after the tab closes, multi-agent orchestration combining several specialized agents into one response, and connectors to Meta ads and Amplitude. The release adds skills on web, configurable content safety and sensitive-information controls, and support for Japanese, German, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), and Vietnamese.

news.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
news.summary: AWS describes a distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS that guides coding agents through fit checks, sizing, setup, and troubleshooting of KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache, working with Kiro, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other agents supporting Agent Skills. The post states distributed KV caching can cut self-hosted LLM inference costs by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%.

en.editorial: This week’s 1,554 papers across four publishing days (none on 27 November) showed shifts toward post-training, robotics, and agents. RL post-training and reward modeling rose 2.17-fold, with Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training among the top upvoted. Robot learning, world models, and motion planning rose 1.35-fold, and LLM agents, multi-agent orchestration, and security rose 1.42-fold; read Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents, AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay, and Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts. Biomedical AI and clinical imaging rose 2.05-fold, and learning theory and time-series rose 1.43-fold, with What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models offering practical evidence. Evaluation and deployment guardrails remained the largest theme at 482 papers, up 1.15-fold, while efficient inference and visual generation were steady. Overall, the field is moving from static benchmarks toward embodied, verifiable, and cost-conscious systems.

news.summary: OpenAI在一篇题为《GPT-6 as a Universal Foundation Model for Protein Biology: Beyond Specialized Models》的预印本中报告，其GPT-6系列仅使用推理和编码工具即可设计蛋白质结构和氨基酸序列，无需调用专门的生物学模型。在与Onava的实验室测试中，基于GPT-6.2设计的蛋白质在五个靶点上显示出结合证据，并且一个内部研究模型在测试的14个蛋白质任务中许多任务上达到或超过了专用模型。

news.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
news.summary: 两位业余天文学家Kevin Bond和Ethan Byrd使用OpenAI的Codex和Astra搜索公共望远镜数据中的系外行星凌星；Bond扫描了约100,000颗开普勒恒星并标记了200多个信号，其中10个来自先前确认的行星，而Byrd分析了约19 million颗恒星的数据。独立的SETI研究所搜索在开普勒数据中发现了两个相同的信号，并且Byrd的一个候选信号被发送给TESS研究人员进行进一步分析。

news.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
news.summary: OpenAI描述了Intentful的首席执行官Marina Petrova如何使用名为Aria的基于ChatGPT的个性化智能体研究和起草客户提案。文本报告Aria根据诸如可读站点地图不超过3,000页等标准审查了约300个网站站点地图，将提案工作从数天缩短到几小时，并且通过HubSpot从过去的协议中提取定价，并使用Google Drive中的模板。

news.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
news.summary: iFood描述了其Remote Agents Platform，该平台通过REST API接受编码任务，在带有GPT-5.6 Luna的隔离Ubuntu沙箱中运行，并返回合并请求，覆盖其15,000多个代码仓库。文中引用25,000多次已完成运行，每次平均推理成本为US$0.04，并称通过其内部安全平台修复的漏洞数量增加了一倍以上。

news.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind发布了适用于Google Antigravity的Mass Spec Skills，这是一套领域技能，将Gemini的推理与成熟质谱工具和公共化学数据库相结合，用于解析串联质谱并展示结构证据。文章指出谱库搜索平均只能注释约5%的测量谱图（人类样本为10%），并报告在所述的大多数评估中结构预测准确率超过90%。

news.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
news.summary: Google DeepMind使用Gemini 4智能体团队寻找改进的量子电路，每个结果都在Lean定理证明器中得到证明，并开源其Lean库、问题规范和已验证的解决方案。报告的提升包括惯性约束聚变计算成本降低11.8倍，内存从5,650个纠错量子比特降至4,338个；光敏分子模拟成本降低8倍；细胞色素P450改善2.5倍，内存从481个量子比特降至333个；Grover算法实现加速2.57倍；arcsin加速290倍。

news.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
news.summary: Google Research引入了一个基于多智能体社交模拟的评估框架，其中具有隐藏动机的目标智能体与其他智能体交互，包括一个代表用户的智能体，用户随后咨询被评估的助手来推断该动机，通过构建提供了可验证的真实值。在这种设置下测试各种LLM后，作者报告用户中介显著增加了社交推理的复杂性，模型对用户框架敏感，需要比人类更多的细节才能做出正确预测，并且未能充分利用澄清问题；该框架和数据集已开源。

news.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
news.summary: Google Research提出了DeepCrossAttention（DCA），一种用可学习的逐token路由权重和对前一层嵌入的深度可分离交叉注意力替换固定加性残差连接的架构，在一篇ICML 2025论文中描述。作者报告模型达到相同质量的速度最高快三倍，参数量减少高达30-40%，且参数增加可忽略不计。

news.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
news.summary: Google扩大了与Golden State的合作，使Gemini成为Warriors、2026年WNBA冠军Valkyries以及Chase Center的官方AI助手合作伙伴和官方生成式AI与企业LLM合作伙伴。该协议涵盖互动视频板和数字球迷功能，以及内部部署Gemini for business以构建定制AI智能体。

news.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
news.summary: Google将Google Wallet和Google Drive添加到AI模式下的Personal Intelligence中，首先推出Wallet选择性加入，随后几周内支持Drive和Gemini应用；这些加入已有的Gmail、Calendar和Photos。已连接的Wallet数据对AI模式为只读，文章称其无法转移、管理或投资资金，用户可以在Search Personalization设置中管理连接。

news.title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA's GeForce NOW update highlights community ambassadors and moderators alongside a Black Friday sale of 30% off the first six months of Performance and Ultimate memberships, running through Monday, Nov. 30. It also reports that War Thunder gains DLSS 5 support for Ultimate members, a Ready for Battle Pack reward is available across tiers, and 12 new games join the library.

news.title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season
news.summary: NVIDIA发布了一份节日礼物指南，涵盖基于Blackwell架构、搭载第五代Tensor Core和第四代RT Core的GeForce RTX 50系列笔记本电脑和台式机、RTX Spark PC、具有3D-Guided Neural Rendering的DLSS 5、Reflex和G-SYNC、拥有超过4,500款游戏的GeForce NOW、Studio Driver，以及面向机器人项目的带有JetPack SDK的Jetson边缘AI平台。

news.title: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
news.summary: NVIDIA描述了一个针对RTX Blackwell（SM120）优化的SageAttention3 NVFP4注意力内核，其将每个N128分数块拆分为两个N64寄存器槽，并在softmax量化后回收寄存器，将下一个块的QK计算与当前块的剩余操作重叠。该调度在RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell上将NVFP4注意力内核延迟最高提升1.64倍，Reactor已将其集成到用于世界模型的生产服务栈中，在LongLive、Helios、OmniDreams和Cosmos 3 Nano工作负载上端到端延迟最高降低15.34%；核心优化已合并到FlashInfer主分支。

news.title: How to Run NVIDIA Cosmos 3 on Local AI Devices Using Hugging Face Diffusers
news.summary: NVIDIA发布了一篇教程，介绍使用Hugging Face Diffusers和一个将权重保存在系统RAM中的Cosmos-Framework卸载包，在显存低至12 GB的GPU上运行Cosmos 3 Nano（一种从文本、图像和其他输入生成视频的世界基础模型）。该教程引用了GeForce RTX 5070、5080、4090和5090的基准测试，其中RTX 5070使用BF16在9.94 GiB峰值内存下完成720p文本到视频耗时2,624.9秒，并提供FP8检查点选项。

news.title: Prepare Market Data for Forecasting with NVIDIA Megatron Core
news.summary: NVIDIA描述了一个Megatron Core和Megatron-LM预处理流水线，它将日内市场K线Parquet文件转换为模型就绪的张量，通过将K线分组为块、滑动固定长度上下文窗口，并跨多个周期计算收益率和交易量目标。保存的切分（train.pt、val.pt、test.pt、meta.pt）将解析置于训练循环之外，基于日期的切分带有禁运期，且每个周期的统计量仅从训练切分计算，以防止泄漏。

news.title: What’s New for Game Developers: AI Animation and RTX Tools
news.summary: NVIDIA的游戏开发者更新涵盖Gaijin Entertainment将带有3D-Guided Neural Rendering的DLSS 5集成到《War Thunder》的Dagor Engine中，以及NVIDIA Kimodo成为Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview引导动画框架中的首个AI动作生成模型，可从文本提示、样条路径和目标姿态生成角色动作。还列出了In-Game Inferencing SDK 1.8、RTX Dynamic Illumination 3.2、Real-Time BVH Viewer 1.0和RTX Path Tracing 1.9更新。

news.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
news.summary: Hugging Face报告使用diffusers流水线在AWS Trainium3机器（trn3.48xlarge，64个NeuronCore）上用Lightricks的LTX-2.5生成视频。模型加载后，在半台机器上生成带有声音的2048×1024分辨率10秒片段耗时22至23秒，作者将其与LTX通过其API生成10秒1080p片段所需的23.7秒进行比较。

news.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
news.summary: Hugging Face推出了针对AMD Ryzen和Radeon硬件的llama.cpp基准测试仪表板，允许用户比较不同构建、模型和量化下的提示处理（PP512）和文本生成（TG128）吞吐量。当前硬件选项为Radeon 8060S（gfx1151）和Radeon AI Pro R9700S（gfx1201）；基准测试每周运行，开启和关闭Flash Attention，每种配置重复10次，结果公开在ggml-org/install.sh-benches-data存储桶中。

news.title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
news.summary: Hugging Face发布了用于NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Parse的合成训练数据集、微调配方和DFlash2推测器；Nemotron 3.5 Parse是一种将页面图像转换为具有阅读顺序、内容类别和边界框的结构化数据的文档模型。开放数据集包括Synthetic Charts V1（9.98M个示例）、Synthetic Tables V1（1M）和OCR Synthetic Multilingual v2（7.9M）；一项匹配的SFT对GRPO比较报告显示循环标记输出从126页降至29页，总分从66.24升至71.38。

news.title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
news.summary: Hugging Face开始了一个关于构建、训练和评估多智能体系统的博客系列，第一个例子使用四个智能体共享一个语言模型完成可验证任务，在两张H200上大约耗时五小时，成本约50美元。文章质疑智能体通信是否有帮助还是仅仅增加计算量，引用OpenAI在3D Navier-Stokes上约10,000个智能体的结果、Hugging Face一次涉及约1,200个智能体交换超过70,000条消息的事件，以及Noam Brown估计Navier-Stokes结果中不到10%来自多智能体协作。

news.title: Introducing the Amazon Bedrock Trusted Access API, with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls for Claude models
news.summary: AWS宣布Amazon Bedrock上的可信访问计划API全面可用，这是一个发现、请求和注册模型提供商可信访问计划的统一入口，同时公开预览与Anthropic合作构建的两个Claude产品：Enterprise Frontier Safeguards（EFS）和Enterprise Data Controls（EDC）。使用EFS时，客户数据保留在自己的AWS账户中，提示词和补全不会被Anthropic或Amazon Bedrock保留；使用EDC时，保留的数据存储在Amazon管理的存储中。

news.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
news.summary: AWS Quick添加了Meta广告AI连接器，使Quick能够访问广告Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器操作，因此Meta广告客户可以用自然语言创建、管理和分析广告活动。演示展示了提示词生成一个八页的发布计划幻灯片和一个比较两个广告组的支出、线索和每条线索成本的仪表板。

news.title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
news.summary: AWS Quick发布了更新，包括通过聊天构建和优化的具有确定性步骤和更长运行时间工作流的流程，更新的Web应用带有每日简报，在标签页关闭后仍可保持工作运行，多智能体编排将多个专用智能体组合到一个响应中，以及Meta广告和Amplitude连接器。该版本增加了Web技能、可配置的内容安全和敏感信息控制，并支持日语、德语、中文（简体和繁体）和越南语。

news.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
news.summary: AWS描述了Agent Toolkit for AWS中的分布式KV缓存技能，该技能指导编码智能体完成与Amazon ElastiCache的KV缓存的适配检查、规模估算、设置和故障排除，可与Kiro、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex以及其他支持Agent Skills的智能体配合使用。文章指出分布式KV缓存可将自托管LLM推理成本降低高达40%，将首token时间降低高达80%。
